title_sq: Tek Pazari I Ri, Shitet Garsoniere Me Mundesi Konvertimi Ne 1+1 !!
description_sq: Ne zonen e Pazarit te Ri, ne rrugen Fadil Rada, Shitet Garsoniere me mundesi konvertimi ne apartament 1+1. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e trete te nje pallati te ri te mireadministruar me dy ashensor. Garsonieria ka siperfaqe prej 45 m2 dhe organizohet nga korridori hyres, ambienti i ndenjes, ambienti i gatimit me vete dhe me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti. Orientimi eshte jug-perendim, cka do te thote qe ka drite natyrale dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Duke patur parasysh siperfaqen dhe planimetrine e garsonieres, mund te konvertohet shume lehte ne apartament 1+1. Gjithashtu eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per banim edhe per investim pasi kerkesat per qira jane shume te larta. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: At the New Bazaar, studio for sale with the possibility of conversion to 1+1 !!
description_en: In the area of ​​Pazar te Ri, on Fadil Rada Street, a studio for sale with the possibility of conversion into a 1+1 apartment. The apartment is located on the third floor of a new, well-managed building with two elevators. The studio has a surface area of ​​45 m2 and is organized by the entrance corridor, the living room, the kitchen area with access to the balcony and the toilet. The orientation is south-west, which means that there is natural light and sun throughout the day. Considering the surface area and floor plan of the studio, it can be easily converted into a 1+1 apartment. It is also a very good opportunity both for housing and for investment, since the demands for rent are very high. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
